_label: PHASE 3 BATCH 2 — remaining Moon-sign application claims; universal, development only, practitioner review required
scope: Moon signs Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Libra, Scorpio, Capricorn, Sagittarius and Pisces. Leo, Virgo and Aquarius remain in the tested Lisbon, Denver and Chicago overlays and are not duplicated here.
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. Classical source history, excluded predictions, stereotypes and technical factors remain internal trace.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Emotional responses may arise quickly and directly rather than developing slowly out of view.
Even when a reaction is immediate, you may be able to soften, relent or move forward rather than remain fixed indefinitely.
You may meet emotionally demanding situations with courage and a willingness to act.
A need for movement or change may sometimes compete with the patience required to remain with one feeling or situation.

compositionRequirements: APP-MOON-ARIES-QUICK-RESPONSE and APP-MOON-ARIES-RELENTING must appear together when either is used.
prohibitedExtensions: claim that feelings pass quickly in every situation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: The emotional temperament may favor steadiness and continuity over rapid or unnecessary change.
You may have the capacity to remain emotionally present with something important over time.
Forgiveness and generosity may help you restore emotional balance after disappointment.
Friendship may be approached with loyalty and a desire to remain dependable.
The mind may respond with agility, wit and an ability to see more than one way of expressing an idea.
Speech may be engaging or persuasive, especially when you have had time to understand what they want to communicate.
Music, dance, language or another learned art may provide the mind with meaningful stimulation.

prohibitedExtensions: scattered attention or inability to commit
automatic emotional verbalization without a supporting house or Mercury factor
guaranteed intelligence, eloquence or artistic talent

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: You may respond especially well to communication that is gentle, considerate and emotionally respectful.
Trusted friendships may contribute meaningfully to emotional ease.
A comfortable home or restorative surroundings, particularly settings connected with nature or water, may help the mind settle.
The emotional state may move and fluctuate, making it important not to treat every passing mood as a permanent conclusion.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic nurturer, mothering or domestic-role claim
claim that water has a medical or spiritual effect

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: The mind may understand a feeling by comparing perspectives and considering how different parts of a situation relate to one another.
Fairness and balanced exchange may influence whether a situation feels emotionally settled.
Learning and thoughtful consideration may give the mind a constructive way to reach clarity.
Considering several sides may support fairness, but it may also delay a decision when you continues weighing after the essential truth is already clear.

compositionRequirements: APP-MOON-LIBRA-COMPARISON and APP-MOON-LIBRA-FAIRNESS must be labeled synthesis in trace and may not be represented as direct classical doctrine.
prohibitedExtensions: automatic harmony, charm, beauty or diplomacy

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: You may keep some feelings private until they decide that disclosure is appropriate.
Emotional expression may be selective rather than immediate, particularly when you are still deciding what they wish to reveal.

compositionRequirements: This record is intentionally thin. The planner must contract the Moon-sign paragraph rather than pad it with familiar Scorpio stereotypes.
prohibitedExtensions: trauma, abuse, betrayal or crisis claim
jealousy, manipulation, vengeance or sexual-intensity claim

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Care for close family or trusted people may carry substantial emotional importance.
You may be receptive to thoughtful counsel when it comes from someone whose judgment they respect.
Memory, language or literary interests may give the mind a durable way to organize experience.
Periods of strength and active engagement may alternate with times when motivation is slower to gather.

compositionRequirements: APP-MOON-CAPRICORN-ENERGY-CONTRAST must be presented as a mixed tendency, never as laziness or incapacity.
prohibitedExtensions: automatic ambition, discipline or career focus
laziness or acquisitiveness as a moral judgment

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Generosity may be a natural way of expressing emotional goodwill.
You may communicate with wit and increasing maturity when speaking about matters that carry meaning.
Once emotionally engaged, you may bring considerable energy to action.
You may respond more openly to reasoned persuasion than to pressure or force.

prohibitedExtensions: religious superiority or fixed belief claim

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Learning may provide the mind with a meaningful source of engagement and satisfaction.
You may become emotionally attached to the home, possessions or surroundings that carry familiarity and personal meaning.
Adornment or visually pleasing surroundings may contribute to emotional comfort.

compositionRequirements: This record must remain narrow. The planner must contract the Moon-sign paragraph rather than add familiar Pisces spirituality, empathy or imagination language.
prohibitedExtensions: mysticism, psychic ability or spiritual destiny
empathy, compassion or emotional permeability claim
imagination, escapism, addiction or weak-boundary claim

implementationRequirements: Merge this overlay additively without modifying the Lisbon, Chicago, Denver or Moon-house overlays.
Do not duplicate the existing Moon-sign records for Leo, Virgo or Aquarius.
Route claims exclusively from each claim's purposes field; no sign or claim ID may be hard-coded in pipeline logic.
Contract deliberately thin sign paragraphs, especially Scorpio and Pisces, instead of filling them with conventional stereotypes.
Preserve classifications and prohibited extensions in internal trace.
Unused admitted claims must be logged as ADMITTED_NOT_USED without creating a warning or failure.
A connective reference such as 'those qualities' in a pada paragraph must not cite the nakshatra context claim outside its planned paragraph.
Name the nakshatra once only; introduce the pada without repeating the nakshatra name.
Production must admit zero claims from this file until individual records are practitioner-approved and explicitly made productionEligible.
